desc:
Welcome to DodgeBall! 🔴🔵

⚡ FAST-PACED 4v4 Dodgeball
Team up with friends, knock out the other team and be the last team standing! Best of 5 rounds.

🎮 CONTROLS:
Throw / Catch - CLICK [PC], R2 [CONSOLE], THROW button [MOBILE]
Charged Throw - HOLD CLICK [PC], HOLD R2 [CONSOLE]
Ability - E [PC], L2 [CONSOLE]
Super Throw - R [PC], Y [CONSOLE]

🧤 HOW TO PLAY:
When the ball flies at you, click to catch it. Time it right for a PERFECT catch!
Throw it back fast to build MOMENTUM: every quick throw gets faster.
Fill your SUPER meter and unleash a super throw!

🏆 Unlock jerseys, banners and 20+ abilities, open card packs, climb the weekly leaderboards and claim daily rewards!

🎁 Codes? Find them at the bottom of the SHOP!

💛 LIKE, FAVORITE and JOIN the ProDuck Games group for a FREE Mythic set!
